descriptor.name: HM Land Registry — England and Wales browser ground
descriptor.scope: England and Wales registered freehold title-index coverage; deterministic derived ground, not legal title boundaries.
descriptor.attribution: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons, Crown copyright and database right. Application ground derived by deterministic overlap resolution.
descriptor.licenceNote: Official INSPIRE freehold index downloads are published under the Open Government Licence. Derived ground retains publisher attribution and source provenance.
caveats: Requires a complete, SHA-verified static routing manifest before city bindings are enabled.
Council ZIPs are downloaded and processed in the browser; a transport relay handles the publisher cookie/redirect flow.
Application footprints use deterministic overlap resolution and remain indicative freehold title-index derivatives.
